verdict.rationale: Kong ships first-party declarative configuration tooling. decK is documented as an APIOps command-line toolkit for automating the API lifecycle (kong-docs-4, kong-gh-10). The gateway supports declarative DB-less and hybrid deployments (kong-gh-4, kong-gh-5), and official Terraform providers cover Konnect and on-prem gateway entities (kong-supp-terraform-providers), alongside kongctl and the Kubernetes Ingress Controller. missing for 10: explicit documentation of CI pipeline integration (e.g., diff/sync commands, drift detection, CI examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of GitOps workflows.
